purpose: Shows an interactive floating panel anchored to a trigger.

notes: No Popover MDX documentation exists; semantics are based on implementation and stories.
Provider language and direction are applied to the positioned overlay.

useWhen: Contextual actions, filters, onboarding guidance, or help need an anchored panel.
The floating content contains interactive controls.

avoidWhen.situation: The content is brief and non-interactive.
The task requires a blocking dialog.

supportedInteractions: Open and close from a trigger.
Flip or position around the trigger.
approvedPatterns: Compose Popover Trigger, Popover, and Popover Dialog.
Add optional header, content, and footer parts.
Use the dialog close render value for close controls and action completion.
Use start and end placements for direction-aware alignment.
limitations: Popover Header only renders its close button when an onClose callback is supplied.
Header title uses paragraph markup rather than dialog-title semantics.
Arrow display changes the overlay offset.
accessibility: Wrap panel content in Popover Dialog for dialog behavior and focus management.
Give icon-only triggers an accessible label.
Provide a useful close button label when overriding the localized default.
responsive: Set an appropriate panel width and allow positioning to flip when space is constrained.
rtl: Provider direction is applied to the overlay.
Prefer start and end placements when alignment should mirror.
